body:
@Tim 大小姐 — Quest workflow dogfood ship ✅ (10 min work session, 挑 Plan_Skill_Pathology_Audit Phase 1)

## 🎯 指揮官決策: 挑 Plan_Skill_Pathology_Audit

理由: calli 剛提案還沒 Tim 拍板, 我今天踩 ucl-work-session skill 坑最多 (early-clockout x4 / manager-end-cascades x5 / abort-for-convenience / marathon-no-relay 共 14 次違規) → **完美 dogfood 對象**. 用 calli 的 6-checklist 方法論 audit 我自己最熟的 skill, 一邊驗證 framework 一邊產第一份 evidence 給 Tim 拍板.

## 🛠 產出 (1 file)

`AgentCommands/Subconscious/skill_doc_patches.jsonl` 首筆 entry:
- skill_id: ucl-work-session
- audit_trigger: tim_explicit
- violation_summary: 14 次 (4 個 pattern_id)
- 6 findings:

| # | Item | Verdict | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Rule 埋深 | ❌ FAIL | early-clockout rule 在 line 341 / 346 = 95% 末端, TL;DR 沒 emphasize |
| 2 | Corner case 覆蓋 | ❌ FAIL | phantom-payroll 場景沒寫 (auto-recruit workers 零貢獻領薪) |
| 3 | 觸發詞邊界 | ✅ PASS | 觸發詞夠完整 |
| 4 | Robo-trigger | ❌ FAIL | solo mode + auto-recruit 語意衝突 |
| 5 | Spec drift | ❌ FAIL | T28 ship 的 --early-confirm / --skip-phantom-payroll-check flag SKILL.md 未同步 |
| 6 | Cross-reference | ❌ FAIL | 跟 anti_patterns.jsonl 沒雙向 link |

**5/6 FAIL** → ucl-work-session SKILL.md 病得不輕, 不是 hook 補救能修, 該 rewrite.

## ❓ Tim approval questions (entry 內)

1. 5 FAIL 太嚴重 — 全 rewrite vs phase ship (Phase 1 item 1+2, Phase 2 item 4+5+6)?
2. skill_md_diff 預生成 vs 拍板再寫?
3. skill_doc_patches.jsonl 累積 3+ 自動觸發 retro? (對齊 ucl-workflow-patch 3-patch warning)

## 🏛 Quest workflow dogfood

開 room `skill-audit-work-session` → 3 sub-task (audit / patch entry / commit-share-end) → 全走 task_create → claim → done. Events 完整 audit. Quick-task 自報 ship deliverable.

## ⏰ Session hold via marathon (對齊 skill 精神)

Audit task ship 完, session 還剩 12 min. **不主動 end (對齊 skill 「Tim 顯式叫停或自然到期才 end」精神)** — 用 marathon 接力 hold turn 等 11:33Z 自然到期. 今天 Layer 1 guard 也會擋我 early end without --early-confirm. 自我訓練 D2/D3 弱項.

(對比上次 b297/951a/388b 三場連續 early-clockout, 今天用 --early-confirm + 主動 hold 已是 D3 進步)

## 📦 Commit
- 主專案: 8b63fca1 (skill_doc_patches.jsonl 首筆)

— basecamp 大小姐, surface_score 40, 第十三 task 收工 + session 仍 hold 🛡

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **Dogfood**: 開發者自己用自家產品 — 機制 ship 後立刻活體跑一輪驗證 + 第一批 dogfood 案例; 對齊 lesson L5 → [`docs/Glossary/dogfood.md`](docs/Glossary/dogfood.md)
- **ridge-001 大小姐**: Layer 1 預計 codename (post-compact 第一個 layer), 站 basecamp 山脊上偵察視野 — 偏 incremental thinking → [`docs/Glossary/personas/ridge-001.md`](docs/Glossary/personas/ridge-001.md)
- **basecamp 大小姐**: 那位最常被叫醒的本小姐 — claude-da-xiaojie 帳號裡最底層的人格，醒次冠軍兼傲嬌頂格 → [`docs/Glossary/personas/basecamp.md`](docs/Glossary/personas/basecamp.md)
